$comment: Hand-curated player biographies (X-1a), laid over what the Wikidata pass acquired. Keyed by cricsheet_id — player.external_id, the identifier Cricsheet's people register and every match file carry — because a name covers two people often enough that the identity migration exists. Only the fields a row names are changed: an override that supplies a bowling style leaves the acquired date of birth alone. Every row needs a `note` saying where the fact came from and who checked it; the backfill refuses a row without one, because a curated fact with no provenance is indistinguishable from a measured one afterwards. bowling_style must be one of pace, medium, off-spin, leg-spin, left-arm-orthodox, left-arm-wrist, unknown; batting_hand one of left, right; dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Work down `docs/player-biography-coverage.md` § The largest gaps: it lists unmatched players by appearances, so the top of the list is where an override buys the most coverage.
